headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 10, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Naylor leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs. Andrés Muñoz earned the save, while Emerson Hancock was credited with the win. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Boston Red Sox 3-1, with Casey Legumina earning the win and Yandy Díaz leading the offense with a home run and two RBIs. The New York Yankees secured a 7-5 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with David Bednar earning the win in relief. The Philadelphia Phillies took down the Toronto Blue Jays 5-2, with Cristopher Sánchez earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 10 strikeouts.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Brian Fitzpatrick, a left-handed pitcher for the Milwaukee Brewers, has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left elbow injury. Jameson Taillon, a right-handed pitcher for the Chicago Cubs, has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 8, 2026. Cooper Criswell, a right-handed pitcher for the Seattle Mariners, has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a right shoulder strain. LaMonte Wade Jr., a first baseman for the Houston Astros, has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain. Tyler Freeman, a right fielder for the Colorado Rockies, has been placed on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. Austin Hays, a left fielder for the Chicago White Sox, has been placed on the 60-day injured list with a left calf strain. Carlos Rodriguez, a right-handed pitcher for the Milwaukee Brewers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 31, 2026. Adam Frazier, a second baseman for the Los Angeles Angels, has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 6, 2026, with right elbow inflammation.

The Arizona Diamondbacks have traded right-handed pitcher Taylor Rashi to the Minnesota Twins in exchange for cash. The Colorado Rockies have acquired shortstop Richie Martin Jr. from the Texas Rangers in exchange for cash. The Los Angeles Dodgers have traded left-handed pitcher Antoine Kelly to the Chicago Cubs in exchange for cash. The Athletics have traded right-handed pitcher Joel Kuhnel to the Milwaukee Brewers in exchange for cash.
